dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Multiple sclerosis with bilateral internuclear ophthalmoplegia due to demyelinating lesions of both medial longitudinal fasciculi

Alternatives:
1. Brainstem stroke (lacunar infarct affecting the MLF bilaterally)
2. Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
3. Neurosarcoidosis involving the brainstem
order_raw:
1. Assess extraocular movements in all cardinal gazes
2. Measure visual acuity in both eyes
3. Perform pupillary light reflex and RAPD test
4. Check visual fields by confrontation
5. Examine the fundus for optic disc appearance
6. Measure intraocular pressure
7. Palpate the thyroid gland and check for goiter
8. Test for lid lag and lid retraction
9. Assess corneal sensation and exposure
10. Perform exophthalmometry
11. Test convergence reflex
12. Order a CT scan of the orbits
dx: Multiple sclerosis with bilateral internuclear ophthalmoplegia due to demyelinating lesions of both medial longitudinal fasciculi
